title: After Super Bowl beatdown, Patriots and QB Drake Maye must avoid the trap that befell other sophomore starters on this stage

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: After Super Bowl beatdown, Patriots and QB Drake Maye must avoid the trap that befell other sophomore starters on this stage
sources.description: The saving grace is that Maye is experiencing this defeat at 23 years old and in his second year as an NFL starter. It now depends on both his own progression and the strides of virtually everything around him in the Patriots organization.
